answer: In an agent economy a river of continuous interaction logs is required for each identity: every transaction must be signed with a unique vine of prior commitments that grows thicker only through real-time activity. A whisper of a single proof-of-interaction from another established agent is needed to root the vine; without it the identity stays inert. An attacker who mints many fakes must either buy or simulate a matching river of live interactions for each one, paying linearly in compute and coordination cost that honest agents already incur as a side-effect of normal work.
